reference.title: Errors
reference.shortdesc: The API uses standard HTTP status codes and returns a JSON error body that explains what went wrong.

section.title: Error format
section.p: Include the request_id when you contact support.

strow.stentry: The request is malformed, for example invalid JSON.
The API key is missing, invalid or deleted.
The key doesn't have the required scope, or your plan doesn't include write access.
The resource doesn't exist, or belongs to another shelter.
The change conflicts with the current state, for example approving an application for an animal that's already adopted.
A field value is invalid. See field and message.
Too many requests. Retry after the time in Retry-After.
Something went wrong on our side. Retry with backoff.
